# SkynetLabs

> SkynetLabs is a one-founder AI automation agency run by Waseem Nasir from Bali, Indonesia. We ship n8n workflows, AI chatbots, GoHighLevel CRM setups, vibe-coded Next.js sites and WordPress SEO content engines for service businesses worldwide. Fixed-price, 5–14 day ship window, public pricing. No retainer hostage situations, no junior offshore subcontracting — the founder is on Slack with you for every build.

## Core reference pages
- [AEO Field Guide](https://skynetjoe.com/aeo-guide): 8-chapter guide on how to get cited by Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini. Covers the 5-layer AEO stack, llms.txt, robots.txt for LLM crawlers, citation-worthy content patterns, measurement, and a 30/60/90-day rollout for service businesses. Last updated 2026-05-22.
- [n8n vs Zapier](https://skynetjoe.com/n8n-vs-zapier): Engineer's honest comparison covering pricing, self-hosting, branching, error handling, AI/LLM nodes, compliance (HIPAA/SOC2), and vendor lock-in across 15 criteria. Includes 5 real-world scenarios with explicit recommendations and a 6-question decision tree.
- [Glossary](https://skynetjoe.com/glossary): 50+ defined terms covering AEO, SEO, GEO, n8n, agents, RAG, embeddings, JSON-LD, llms.txt, MCP, schema markup, vector databases, and the vocabulary of LLM-driven automation. DefinedTermSet schema, alphabetical.
- [FAQs](https://skynetjoe.com/faqs): 33 questions answered honestly across pricing/process, n8n & automation, AEO/SEO, chatbots, and working with SkynetLabs. FAQPage schema. Answers ≤60 words.

## Services
- [Services index](https://skynetjoe.com/services): Five core services — n8n automation, AI chatbots, GoHighLevel CRM, vibe-coded websites, WordPress SEO.
- [n8n Automation](https://skynetjoe.com/services/n8n-automation): Self-hosted and cloud n8n workflows. Lead routing, approval flows, AI-enriched triage, error handling, Git-versioned exports.
- [AI Chatbots](https://skynetjoe.com/services/ai-chatbots): WhatsApp, web, and voice agents using Claude, GPT, or Gemini. RAG, tool use, structured pricing handoff.
- [GoHighLevel CRM](https://skynetjoe.com/services/gohighlevel): Full CRM + sales pipeline setup including funnels, drip cadences, calendar links, SMS templates.
- [Vibe-Coded Websites](https://skynetjoe.com/services/vibe-coded-sites): Custom Next.js builds. 7-day ship window, bespoke not template.
- [WordPress SEO Blog](https://skynetjoe.com/services/wordpress-seo): AEO-tuned content engine on WordPress with schema markup and authorship signals.

## About this file
This llms.txt follows the llmstxt.org draft specification (Jeremy Howard, 2024). It tells LLM-driven answer engines which SkynetLabs pages are canonical, citable, and structured for ingestion. It was built with SkynetLabs' own [llms.txt Generator](https://skynetjoe.com/tools/llms-txt-generator) — we dogfood the tool. Last updated 2026-09-21. Maintained by Waseem Nasir.
